description.value: Coffee on the Moon is a community-rooted café in downtown Duncan that has been a local gathering place since 1997, serving espresso drinks, teas, smoothies, and a food menu including bagels, paninis, salads, and baked goods with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. The café doubles as a rotating gallery space for Cowichan Valley artists, giving it a distinctive neighbourhood character. The website references two Duncan locations, though this OSM node represents a single point.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Coffee on the Moon is a real, active café at 501 Canada Avenue in downtown Duncan, operating since 1997. The OSM phone number (+1-250-597-0545) differs from the website's listed number (250-715-1540), so the website value is used and the discrepancy is flagged. The menu page explicitly confirms takeout service and vegetarian/vegan/GF food options; no bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-597-0545 but website consistently shows 250-715-1540 — website number used.
Website title and header reference '2 Locations Duncan BC'; this OSM node is a single point and it is unclear which of the two locations it represents.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café in downtown Duncan with a confirmed website, clear address, and operating history since 1997.
